newsitem.title: USA: Mercury says feds execute search warrant.
newsitem.headline: Mercury says feds execute search warrant.

text.p: Federal investigators executed a search warrant at troubled auto finance firm Mercury Finance Co.'s home office in Lake Forest, Ill., the company said Monday.
Mercury Finance said it was cooperating fully with federal investigators and was producing materials requested under the warrant.

Earlier Monday, Mercury named bankruptcy and turnaround specialist William Brandt Jr. president and chief executive officer, replacing John Brincat, who will remain an employee and director of the company.
The used-car loan company said on Wednesday it had found problems in its bookkeeping that caused it to overstate earnings by $90 million over four years.
It blamed the misstatements on Mercury's former controller, James Doyle. Doyle's attorntey accused the company of a charade and said his client was cooperating with federal authorities.
